items.title: 67520_George Handy oral history interview
items.q: Hy Mandel is a rather bad saxophone player; I've always felt he was terrible, yet in that band he played his part, never got in the way, never interfered.

ctx.x: could fill the demands of the chair, that's all you need to create a great band.

Hy Mandel is a rather bad saxophone player; I've always felt he was terrible, yet in that band he played his part, never got in the way, never interfered. He was right for the chair,for the time, for the music.
Was he a jazz player at all?
